title: fix(app-shell): Studio's page previews draw the page's own kind, as the running app does (objectui#11933)
body:
Fixes #11933

Clause-②: no
Surface amended by the seat: `PagePreview.tsx` (card Done-when bullet 1)

## What was wrong

A page's KIND (`app`, `home`, `record`, `utility`) rides two keys on the node handed to `SchemaRenderer`: the node `type` that `ComponentRegistry` dispatches on, and a copy on `pageType`, which `PageRenderer` reads for the page's max-width, its `data-page-type` and whether it draws the implicit title heading. The running app's `PageView` wrote both. Studio's two page previews wrote `type` only:

- the live preview beside an `html` / `react` page's source (`SourcePageEditor`, `previewSchema`);
- the Interfaces page canvas in Run mode (`PagePreview`, its `schema` memo).

So `PageRenderer` fell back to `record` and an `app` or `home` page previewed at the record width with no title heading, while the running app drew both. That breaks the previews' contract, quoted from `SourcePageEditor`'s header: "a live preview rendered through the runtime SchemaRenderer".

## The change

- New module-private builder `pageKindNode` beside `PageView` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/pageKindNode.ts`). It returns `{ type: page.type || 'page', pageType: page.type }`, which is exactly the pair `PageView` wrote inline. It is not exported from the package entry.
- `PageView`, `SourcePageEditor` and `PagePreview` all spread it, so the three writers cannot drift again. `PageView`'s output is unchanged.
- Page shape only: `PageView`'s `context: { params }` and its two providers stay with that writer, because a preview has no URL.
- `PagePreview` needed one more line. Its empty-draft check counted the memo's keys (at most one key meant empty), and the builder's `pageType` key would have moved that count. It now asks the draft's own keys, with `type` set aside. That is the same predicate the old count expressed. The second ablation leg below shows the line is load-bearing.

Hypothesis reading (H1): the preview dropped exactly one page-shape key, `pageType`. It also used a different fallback operator (`??` where `PageView` uses `||`), which differs only for an empty-string `type`. The title heading and the width class are not separate keys. `PageRenderer` derives both from `pageType` (`getPageMaxWidth`, and `headerOwnsTitle` reading `pageType === 'record'`), and the title text is `title ?? label`, which every writer carries through the spread.

## Pins (real `SchemaRenderer`, real `ComponentRegistry`, real `PageRenderer`)

Widths are compared, never hard-coded. The classes are `PageRenderer`'s choice; this card owns only that a non-record page does not get the record width.

- `SourcePageEditor.pageKind-11933.test.tsx` (preview half; only the Monaco loader is mocked offline, as in the sibling source-page tests):
  - CONTROL: a `record` page draws exactly as an untyped page does. That is the renderer's record default: no h1, same width.
  - `app` and `home` draw `data-page-type` equal to the kind, the title heading, and a width that is not the record width.
  - Every region-composed kind read from `PageTypeSchema` reaches the renderer as itself.
- `PagePreview.pageKind-11933.test.tsx` (Run-mode render, no design mode):
  - The same `record` CONTROL, and the same `app` / `home` cases.
  - CONTROL: an empty draft, typed or not, still shows the add-components message and draws no page.
- `page-kind-writing-end-9718` still pins `PageView`'s write, kind by kind, and is unchanged and green. Card bullet 3: it is not widened. Each preview's write is pinned at render level beside that preview, and all three writers spread one builder.

## Ablations (fix committed first; `ablation-replace.mjs`, which verifies on disk and restores to HEAD)

For `app` and `home` the pin expected the kind and received `record`; the record CONTROL stayed green. The restore matched the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `PagePreview`, run at `811475cd3`:
  - Leg 1: the pre-fix `type`-only memo was restored (blob `b29ef4ae1128` to `5da520728ac5`). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. For `app` and `home` the pin expected the kind and received `record`.
  - Leg 2: the old key-count predicate was restored (blob `b29ef4ae1128` to `13ca9d01052d`). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. Both empty-draft CONTROLs went red.
  - Both legs restored to the HEAD blob `b29ef4ae1128` with `git diff HEAD` empty.
